_comment:
Affiliate ad slot config. assets/ads.js renders these into
placeholders. Set enabled=false to silence all slots site-wide (no DOM changes needed). One-command rollback: bash scripts/disable_affiliate_ads.sh.
_enabled_note: Disabled until the operator signs up at eventbrite.com/affiliate-program and partner.getyourguide.com. When IDs are pasted in below, flip enabled=true.

eventbrite.label: Tickets
eventbrite.note: Direct ticket-flow conversion. Highest match for our traffic (every show on the site links to EB).

getyourguide.label: Things to do in Paris
getyourguide.note: Paris tourism context. Plays nicely on venue pages + index footer for visitors. ~8% commission on bookings.

shows-sidebar.headline: Get tickets
shows-sidebar.body: Most Paris shows sell out same-day. Book ahead through our partner Eventbrite — same price, supports the site.

venues-inline.headline: While you're in Paris
venues-inline.body: Skip-the-line tickets and tours near every venue we list. Curated via GetYourGuide.

index-footer-rail.headline: Plan the rest of your night
index-footer-rail.body: Dinner spots, walking tours, day trips. Paris-tested experiences from GetYourGuide.

comic-footer.headline: Catch them live
comic-footer.body: Most comics on this site have upcoming dates. Tickets through Eventbrite.
